rows.name: Steakhouse Financial

steps: Use a fresh wallet that holds only the funds you plan to farm, and keep its seed phrase offline. Cost: about $0.50 of gas for the first transaction. Time: 5 minutes.
Deposit $1000 into a Steakhouse Financial vault on Base and keep the shares. Cost: $1,000 of capital and about $0.50 of gas. Time: 15 minutes to set up.
Each week, check the Steakhouse Financial vault on Base and add $25 when the vault is open. Cost: about $0.50 of gas a week. Time: 10 minutes a week.
Hold the position for at least 30 days so the activity is counted in more than one snapshot. Cost: the $1,000 stays in the position. Time: 30 days.
Before you withdraw, open the protocol's own points or rewards page and claim only from the link it publishes. Cost: no fee to check, and never pay to claim. Time: 10 minutes.
Write the wallet, the dates and every transaction in a farm log so you can repeat the position or unwind it. Cost: nothing but the log. Time: 5 minutes.

Mint $1000 of the protocol's yield asset on Stellar and hold it. Cost: $1,000 of capital and about $0.50 of gas. Time: 15 minutes to set up.
Each week, hold the Defa By InvoiceMate position on Stellar and top it up by $25 when you can. Cost: about $0.50 of gas a week. Time: 10 minutes a week.
Hold the position for at least 45 days so the activity is counted in more than one snapshot. Cost: the $1,000 stays in the position. Time: 45 days.
Before you withdraw, open the protocol's own points or rewards page and claim only from the link it publishes. Cost: no fee to check, and never pay to claim. Time: 10 minutes.
Write the wallet, the dates and every transaction in a farm log so you can repeat the position or unwind it. Cost: nothing but the log. Time: 5 minutes.
